thread:
maria-cs: Heads-up — HelixFin escalated their SIG/CAIQ review. They want: retention matrix for audit logs, KMS key rotation policy, HSM attestation, and a redacted audit-log sample. They also reported an API 401 spike while trying to pull logs during their export. Due EOD Wednesday. Who can own evidence + repro?

anshu-solutions: I can draft the SIG answers text. Need the exact window for the 401s and a sample log extract (redacted). Also confirm whether they want exported logs or just a CSV sample.

maria-cs: They tried a full export from 2026-03-05T00:00 to 2026-03-05T06:00. HelixFin says about ~50k requests and saw ~120 401s and a billing spike. They asked if our KMS rotation caused auth failures.

tony-eng: Can you paste the error lines? 401s could be client token expiry, clock skew, or an auth-service regression. If it's on our side we should be able to repro with the same timeframe.

maria-cs: Paste from customer (redacted):
```
2026-03-05T01:12:08Z GET /v1/audit/export 200 X-Req-Id: abc123
2026-03-05T01:12:12Z GET /v1/audit/export 401 X-Req-Id: def456 auth: token not found
2026-03-05T01:12:13Z GET /v1/audit/export 401 X-Req-Id: ghi789 auth: token not found
2026-03-05T01:12:18Z GET /v1/audit/export 200 X-Req-Id: jkl012
```
(Helix removed user ids)

rachel-security: For SIG we need three things: (1) formal retention matrix (how long audit logs stored per log-type + legal hold options), (2) KMS rotation & key custodianship statement, (3) HSM attestation (cert + date). I can provide canned language and an attestation PDF, but we also need a redacted audit-log sample showing schema. Tim, can ops run the export playbook and redact PII?

tim-ops: I'll run the playbook now. Command I use internally:
```
rwi audit export --start 2026-03-05T00:00 --end 2026-03-05T06:00 \
  --filter event_type=auth,export --redact-email --redact-ids --out s3://redwood-temp/helixfin-redacted/2026-03-05.jsonl
```
I expect a link in ~30m. Note: if they triggered many parallel exports we might have hit rate limits which can cause 429s and client retries -> billing bump.

anshu-solutions: For the SIG answers I'll need: retention periods (default + enterprise override), KMS policy name and rotation cadence, SKUs for HSM attestation (if we use partner HSM), and a clean sample log. Rachel, I can wire up the canned text and a short explanatory paragraph about redaction.

tony-eng: Quick note — I checked auth service traces for that window and saw a small window (2026-03-05T01:11:50Z–01:14:00Z) where our token-introspection cache was being refreshed and returned "not found" for ~0.2% of calls. That aligns with the customer 401s. Logs show a retry storm from the client causing increased egress and token validation calls. Snippet from our side:
```
[2026-03-05T01:12:12Z] token-introspect id=def456 err="not found" backend_latency=123ms
[2026-03-05T01:12:13Z] token-introspect id=ghi789 err="not found" backend_latency=118ms
[2026-03-05T01:12:14Z] auth-service cache-refresh start
[2026-03-05T01:12:15Z] auth-service cache-refresh done duration=1.2s
```
I don't think KMS key rotation caused it — key ops logs show no rotations at that hour.

rachel-security: Good catch, Tony. For the SIG language we can state: "No customer-facing key rotations occurred during the requested export window. Our KMS enforces automated rotation every 90 days; emergency rotations are logged and auditable." I'll attach the rotation policy doc and the HSM attestation once Tim's export is ready.

tim-ops: Export done and redacted. S3 link (internal): s3://redwood-temp/helixfin-redacted/2026-03-05.jsonl (shared with security + cs). File size ~8MB. Notes: export ran as a single bulk job; Helix's client retried on 429s which likely drove retries and billing.

maria-cs: Forwarded the redacted sample and Rachel's draft to HelixFin. They asked if we can commit to a retention exception (180 days) and also asked for a signed attestation.

rachel-security: Retention exception is supported for enterprise customers under contract; we need legal signoff + updated SOW. I'll prepare the attestation PDF and a draft exception clause.

anshu-solutions: Action items: (1) I will deliver the SIG answer spreadsheet + explanatory paragraph by COB tomorrow. (owner: anshu-solutions) (2) Rachel will upload HSM attestation + rotation policy doc. (owner: rachel-security) (3) Tim finished export; please confirm S3 link access for Helix via presigned URL (owner: tim-ops). (4) Tony will add a short note explaining the transient auth cache refresh and mitigation (owner: tony-eng). Maria please confirm due date with customer and close loop.

maria-cs: Confirmed — Helix accepts COB Thurs for full SIG bundle but asked for interim evidence (redacted sample + rotation stmt) today. I'll send the interim now. :eyes:

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled token-introspect-cache-refresh runs daily at 01:12:00 UTC.

tony-eng: I'll follow up with a mitigation plan to reduce client retry amplification (rate-limiting + 429 backoff guidance) and share a short KB they can follow. :thumbsup:

maria-cs: Thanks team — keeping this thread as the single source. If anything else comes from Helix I'll post here.
